create.name: Sabine Priestley
create.bio:
Sabine Priestley is a Florida-based meditation teacher and intuitive coach who came to spiritual work from a career in electrical engineering. A personal upheaval in 2016 set her on an inward path, and since then she has studied where physics, energy and consciousness meet, drawing on writers and researchers such as Bruce Lipton, Joe Dispenza, Lynne McTaggart, Nassim Haramein and Gregg Braden. She trained as a PSYCH-K facilitator in Taos, New Mexico, in 2019 and for several years worked as an advanced Bio-Well practitioner, reading the body's energy field with a camera-based device, though she stopped offering scans in 2026.

She calls her approach Conscious Quantum Living: practical work with the energy centres, the restless 'monkey mind' and inner critic, inner-child meditation and the stories we inherit, set alongside ancient frameworks such as the seven Hermetic principles. Her teaching comes as short talks and guided meditations, an eight-week self-paced course and a nine-day Hermetic course on her own platform, and several free series. On Insight Timer she offers talks and courses on energy, mindset and self-mastery. She still takes a small number of private coaching clients, booked through a free introductory call. She also writes science-fiction romance novels under the same name.

courses.title: Conscious Quantum Living Course
courses.description: Her main course: eight weeks of self-paced talks, meditations and weekly toolboxes. It moves from the restless mind and the energy centres through inner-child work and ideas about higher dimensions, towards a truer sense of who you are beneath old beliefs.

courses.title: Unlocking Universal Wisdom: The 7 Hermetic Principles
courses.description: A nine-lesson online course that takes the seven Hermetic principles, from mentalism and correspondence to vibration and polarity, one at a time, with practical ways to apply each in daily life.

courses.title: Rewriting Your Life Stories Through Quantum Alchemy And Conscious Self-Mastery
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course of short daily sessions on spotting the inherited and unconscious stories that run a life, looking at ego, soul and higher self, and writing a kinder, more responsible story in their place.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Private Coaching with Sabine
courses.description: One-to-one intuitive coaching on energy, mindset and inner guidance, arranged after a free half-hour introductory call. She no longer advertises it widely and gives details and pricing on the call.

free_resources.title: Sabine Priestley on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Talks, guided meditations and short courses on the energy body, the Hermetic principles and taming the inner critic. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Elevate Your Energy: Free Talks and Meditations
free_resources.description: A free series of nine talks and guided meditations in three parts, introducing the energy body and simple ways to raise your frequency and widen awareness.

free_resources.title: Taming The Monkey Mind & Inner Critic
free_resources.description: A free three-day audio course, about half an hour in all, on noticing the chatter in your head, turning critical thoughts around and settling into calmer awareness.

free_resources.title: Cultivating Self-Love and Self-Worth
free_resources.description: A short free talk with a downloadable PDF guide on building self-love and a steadier sense of your own worth.

free_resources.title: Free Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: Three meditation downloads from her site: Elevate Humanity, and two Energy Center Flow practices that move through the energy centres and connect with the quantum field.
